News_Title_1: Indonesia Garment Export Resilience: 5.78% Growth in 2024-2025
News_Snippet_1: Analyzing Indonesia's textile industrial intelligence: Apparel sector records a robust 5.78% growth as investment in labor-intensive manufacturing surges by 124.9% in 2024.
News_Body_1: DigestexGlobal Intelligence Radar reports a significant upward trajectory in the Indonesian apparel manufacturing sector. According to the Ministry of Industry, the apparel industry grew by 5.78% throughout 2024. This growth is backed by a massive investment leap in labor-intensive garment sectors, rising from IDR 4.53 trillion to IDR 10.20 trillion. Strategic export destinations like the USA and emerging Asian markets remain the core focus for 2025 global supply chain synergy.
